_readme: Every photo in public/images. alt = Danish description for screen readers. use = where it fits. ratio = width/height. source = where the file came from: "gammel hjemmeside" (the old Wix site, maybe not Kristine's own photos, replace these first), "Facebook" or "Instagram" (Kristine's own), or the file it was made from. Kristine: replace a file with a new one of the same name, or add a new file and a new entry here.
